subject.title: bug(agents): nodes tool describe action fails with 'node required' due to schema/implementation mismatch

question: What should `nodes` `action: "describe"` do when `node` is omitted?
rationale: The bug is source-reproducible, but the issue discussion and open PR propose different product contracts for omitted-node `describe`; automation cannot safely choose the permanent model-facing behavior without maintainer intent.

options.title: Default-node describe
options.body: Treat omitted-node `describe` as a read-only request for the selected/default node and require regression coverage plus proof before merge.

options.title: List-style discovery
options.body: Return node list or discovery data when `node` is omitted, which better matches the reporter's discovery intent but changes the `describe` response shape.

options.title: Require explicit node
options.body: Make `node` required for `describe` and route discovery through `status`, which avoids implicit target selection but would need schema and prompt/docs alignment.

recommendation.title: Default-node describe
recommendation.body: Treat omitted-node `describe` as a read-only request for the selected/default node and require regression coverage plus proof before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: Peter Steinberger is the strongest history owner for the nodes tool surface and surrounding refactors.
